verses.en: O give thanks unto the LORD; for he is good: because his mercy endureth for ever.
verses.pt: Agradecei ao SENHOR, porque ele é bom; pois sua bondade dura para sempre.
verses.en_web: Give thanks to Yahweh, for he is good, for his loving kindness endures forever.
verses.en_bbe: O give praise to the Lord, for he is good: for his mercy is unchanging for ever.

verses.en: Let Israel now say, that his mercy endureth for ever.
verses.pt: Diga agora Israel, que sua bondade dura para sempre.
verses.en_web: Let Israel now say that his loving kindness endures forever.
verses.en_bbe: Let Israel now say, that his mercy is unchanging for ever.

verses.en: Let the house of Aaron now say, that his mercy endureth for ever.
verses.pt: Diga agora casa de Arão, que sua bondade dura para sempre.
verses.en_web: Let the house of Aaron now say that his loving kindness endures forever.
verses.en_bbe: Let the house of Aaron now say, that his mercy is unchanging for ever.

verses.en: Let them now that fear the LORD say, that his mercy endureth for ever.
verses.pt: Digam agora os que temem ao SENHOR, que sua bondade dura para sempre.
verses.en_web: Now let those who fear Yahweh say that his loving kindness endures forever.
verses.en_bbe: Let all worshippers of the Lord now say, that his mercy is unchanging for ever.

verses.en: I called upon the LORD in distress: the LORD answered me, and set me in a large place.
verses.pt: Na angústia clamei ao SENHOR; e o SENHOR me respondeu, e me pôs num lugar amplo.
verses.en_web: Out of my distress, I called on Yah. Yah answered me with freedom.
verses.en_bbe: I made my prayer to the Lord in my trouble: and the Lord gave me an answer, and put me in a wide place.

verses.en: The LORD is on my side; I will not fear: what can man do unto me?
verses.pt: O SENHOR está comigo, não temerei; o que poderá me fazer o homem?
verses.en_web: Yahweh is on my side. I will not be afraid. What can man do to me?
verses.en_bbe: The Lord is on my side; I will have no fear: what is man able to do to me?

verses.en: The LORD taketh my part with them that help me: therefore shall I see my desire upon them that hate me.
verses.pt: O SENHOR está comigo entre os que ajudam; por isso verei o fim daqueles que me odeiam.
verses.en_web: Yahweh is on my side among those who help me. Therefore I will look in triumph at those who hate me.
verses.en_bbe: The Lord is my great helper: I will see my desire against my haters.

verses.en: It is better to trust in the LORD than to put confidence in man.
verses.pt: Melhor é buscar refúgio no SENHOR do que confiar no homem.
verses.en_web: It is better to take refuge in Yahweh, than to put confidence in man.
verses.en_bbe: It is better to have faith in the Lord than to put one's hope in man.

verses.en: It is better to trust in the LORD than to put confidence in princes.
verses.pt: Melhor é buscar refúgio no SENHOR do que confiar em príncipes.
verses.en_web: It is better to take refuge in Yahweh, than to put confidence in princes.
verses.en_bbe: It is better to have faith in the Lord than to put one's hope in rulers.

verses.en: All nations compassed me about: but in the name of the LORD will I destroy them.
verses.pt: Todas as nações me cercaram; mas foi no nome do SENHOR que eu as despedacei.
verses.en_web: All the nations surrounded me, but in Yahweh’s name, I cut them off.
verses.en_bbe: All the nations have come round me; but in the name of the Lord I will have them cut down.

verses.en: They compassed me about; yea, they compassed me about: but in the name of the LORD I will destroy them.
verses.pt: Cercaram-me, cercaram-me mesmo; mas foi no nome do SENHOR que eu as despedacei.
verses.en_web: They surrounded me, yes, they surrounded me. In Yahweh’s name I indeed cut them off.
verses.en_bbe: They are round me, yes, they are all about me; but in the name of the Lord I will have them cut down.

verses.en: They compassed me about like bees; they are quenched as the fire of thorns: for in the name of the LORD I will destroy them.
verses.pt: Cercaram-me como abelhas, mas se apagaram como fogo de espinhos; porque foi no nome do SENHOR que eu as despedacei.
verses.en_web: They surrounded me like bees. They are quenched like the burning thorns. In Yahweh’s name I cut them off.
verses.en_bbe: They are round me like bees; but they are put out like a fire among thorns; for in the name of the Lord I will have them cut down.

verses.en: Thou hast thrust sore at me that I might fall: but the LORD helped me.
verses.pt: Com força me empurraste para que eu caísse; mas o SENHOR me ajudou.
verses.en_web: You pushed me back hard, to make me fall, but Yahweh helped me.
verses.en_bbe: I have been hard pushed by you, so that I might have a fall: but the Lord was my helper.

verses.en: The LORD is my strength and song, and is become my salvation.
verses.pt: O SENHOR é minha força e minha canção, porque ele tem sido minha salvação.
verses.en_web: Yah is my strength and song. He has become my salvation.
verses.en_bbe: The Lord is my strength and my song; he has become my salvation.

verses.en: The voice of rejoicing and salvation is in the tabernacles of the righteous: the right hand of the LORD doeth valiantly.
verses.pt: Nas tendas dos justos há voz de alegria e salvação; a mão direita do SENHOR faz proezas.
verses.en_web: The voice of rejoicing and salvation is in the tents of the righteous. “The right hand of Yahweh does valiantly.
verses.en_bbe: The sound of joy and salvation is in the tents of the upright; the right hand of the Lord does works of power.

verses.en: The right hand of the LORD is exalted: the right hand of the LORD doeth valiantly.
verses.pt: A mão direita do SENHOR se levanta; a mão direita do SENHOR faz proezas.
verses.en_web: The right hand of Yahweh is exalted! The right hand of Yahweh does valiantly!”
verses.en_bbe: The right hand of the Lord is lifted up; the right hand of the Lord does works of power.

verses.en: I shall not die, but live, and declare the works of the LORD.
verses.pt: Eu não morrerei, mas viverei; e contarei as obras do SENHOR.
verses.en_web: I will not die, but live, and declare Yah’s works.
verses.en_bbe: Life and not death will be my part, and I will give out the story of the works of the Lord.

verses.en: The LORD hath chastened me sore: but he hath not given me over unto death.
verses.pt: É verdade que o SENHOR me castigou, porém ele não me entregou à morte.
verses.en_web: Yah has punished me severely, but he has not given me over to death.
verses.en_bbe: The hand of Jah has been hard on me; but he has not given me up to death.

verses.en: Open to me the gates of righteousness: I will go into them, and I will praise the LORD:
verses.pt: Abri para mim as portas da justiça; entrarei por elas e louvarei ao SENHOR.
verses.en_web: Open to me the gates of righteousness. I will enter into them. I will give thanks to Yah.
verses.en_bbe: Let the doors of righteousness be open to me; I will go in and give praise to the Lord.

verses.en: This gate of the LORD, into which the righteous shall enter.
verses.pt: Esta é a porta do SENHOR, pela qual os justos entrarão.
verses.en_web: This is the gate of Yahweh; the righteous will enter into it.
verses.en_bbe: This is the door of the Lord's house; the workers of righteousness will go in through it.

verses.en: I will praise thee: for thou hast heard me, and art become my salvation.
verses.pt: Eu te louvarei porque tu me respondeste e me salvaste.
verses.en_web: I will give thanks to you, for you have answered me, and have become my salvation.
verses.en_bbe: I will give you praise, for you have given me an answer, and have become my salvation.

verses.en: The stone which the builders refused is become the head stone of the corner.
verses.pt: A pedra que os construtores rejeitaram se tornou cabeça de esquina.
verses.en_web: The stone which the builders rejected has become the cornerstone.
verses.en_bbe: The stone which the builders put on one side has become the chief stone of the building.

verses.en: This is the LORD’S doing; it is marvellous in our eyes.
verses.pt: Pelo SENHOR isto foi feito, e é maravilhoso aos nossos olhos.
verses.en_web: This is Yahweh’s doing. It is marvelous in our eyes.
verses.en_bbe: This is the Lord's doing; it is a wonder in our eyes.

verses.en: This is the day which the LORD hath made; we will rejoice and be glad in it.
verses.pt: Este é o dia em que o SENHOR agiu; alegremos e enchamos de alegria nele.
verses.en_web: This is the day that Yahweh has made. We will rejoice and be glad in it!
verses.en_bbe: This is the day which the Lord has made; we will be full of joy and delight in it.

verses.en: Save now, I beseech thee, O LORD: O LORD, I beseech thee, send now prosperity.
verses.pt: Ah, SENHOR, salva-nos! Ah, SENHOR, faze -nos prosperar!
verses.en_web: Save us now, we beg you, Yahweh! Yahweh, we beg you, send prosperity now.
verses.en_bbe: Send salvation now, O Lord; Lord, send us your blessing.

verses.en: Blessed be he that cometh in the name of the LORD: we have blessed you out of the house of the LORD.
verses.pt: Bendito aquele que vem no nome do SENHOR; nós vos bendizemos desde a casa do SENHOR.
verses.en_web: Blessed is he who comes in Yahweh’s name! We have blessed you out of Yahweh’s house.
verses.en_bbe: A blessing be on him who comes in the name of the Lord; we give you blessing from the house of the Lord.

verses.en: God is the LORD, which hath shewed us light: bind the sacrifice with cords, even unto the horns of the altar.
verses.pt: O SENHOR é o verdadeiro Deus, que nos deu luz; atai os sacrifícios da festa, para levá-los aos chifres do altar.
verses.en_web: Yahweh is God, and he has given us light. Bind the sacrifice with cords, even to the horns of the altar.
verses.en_bbe: The Lord is God, and he has given us light; let the holy dance be ordered with branches, even up to the horns of the altar.

verses.en: Thou art my God, and I will praise thee: thou art my God, I will exalt thee.
verses.pt: Tu és meu Deus, por isso eu te louvarei. Eu te exaltarei, meu Deus.
verses.en_web: You are my God, and I will give thanks to you. You are my God, I will exalt you.
verses.en_bbe: You are my God, and I will give you praise; my God, and I will give honour to your name.

verses.en: O give thanks unto the LORD; for he is good: for his mercy endureth for ever.
verses.pt: Agradecei ao SENHOR, porque ele é bom; pois sua bondade dura para sempre.
verses.en_web: Oh give thanks to Yahweh, for he is good, for his loving kindness endures forever.
verses.en_bbe: O give praise to the Lord, for he is good: for his mercy is unchanging for ever.
